newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen starting up on Nokia, Wall St surge.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen starting up on Nokia, Wall St surge.

text.p: Finnish shares were expected to open higher on Tuesday following Wall Street's surge overnight as investors on both sides of the Atlantic seemed to be more relaxed about the interest rate outlook, brokers said.
"The HEX could open up some 0.7 percent and rise more in the afternoon taking its cue from the U.S.," one broker said.

Nokia gained $1-3/8 to 64-7/8 (333.96 markka) on Wall Street overnight and was seen breaking the 330 markka level in Helsinki as well. "The next target price for Nokia is 340 markka," another said. Nokia's year-high price is 338 markka from May 6 and its all-time high from September 1995 is 340 markka.
Forestries were expected to recover Monday's sharp losses, encouraged by an almost two percent gain in U.S. paper stocks.
Engineering group Rauma was seen continuing to attract interest, particularly from overseas investors.
"Broadly speaking -- cyclicals are still quite fashionable," said one broker.
